protocol.folds: expanding window, one test fold per calendar quarter with enough rows with odds
protocol.tour_inference:
Heuristic circuit label (the dataset has no tour column).

    A player is "known men's circuit" when at least one of his matches was
    matched to the Sackmann ATP files (``player_*_atp_id`` present).
    - ``men_matched``: both players known.
    - ``men_partial``: exactly one player known.
    - ``not_matched``: neither player ever matched (women's circuit and
      unmatched lower-level events; cannot be separated with this dataset).

elo_selection.window: 730 days before the first test fold

train_serve_skew.note: Positive deltas mean the candidate is worse than the reference. All variants are scored out-of-sample on the same test rows.

production_artifact_sensitivity.warning: IN-SAMPLE: the artifact was trained on this dataset; only differences between variants are meaningful.
